text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAH!! DID YOU SEE THAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What an extraordinary run! Reckless! 
Unorthodox! Yet utterly brilliant!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And there you have Vodka! The Umamusume 
who blazes her own solitary trail—has just 
ascended to the very top!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa, Trainer!! You've gotta have 
something to say to me after that, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Of course there is, dammiiiit!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, I'm cool! I managed to 
become it— the absolute coolest Umamusume 
around—!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The one who made me that way was YOU! Damn 
it, DAMN IT ALL!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While shouting, they embraced each other 
tightly, as if to break their very bones.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she was supposed to be cool and 
collected, her body burned hot enough to 
set the Tokyo turf ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—the awards ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's Vodka!! Well, not that there's anyone 
in this country who doesn't know who I am 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I won today! But it wasn't just any 
ordinary win. There are two very important 
things to take from this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Who does she think she is, acting all high 
and mighty...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
First of all! Beating that Daiwa Scarlet 
and taking the Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Winning where she's not around is nothing 
to be proud of. After all, she's—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because you're the number one Umamusume! 
That's why the shield in your hands shines 
so brightly today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
W-What's that supposed to mean?! Don't 
toss it over to me so suddenly! Dummy, 
dummy, dummy!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
And another thing. I won while sticking to 
my own way to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Because this is the only way I know how to 
do it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Vodka looked back on the numerous races 
she had run..."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Staying true to yourself is no ordinary 
feat. There'll be times you bend. Times 
you get snapped in two.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes it's easier to get stronger if 
you just compromise who you are. But 
y'know...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Where's the fun in that?!! There's gotta 
be at least one person attempting the 
impossible!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Even then, you can still win! There are 
times you can win! Sure, you might lose, 
but some folks pull off the victory. And 
you know what?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Winning like that is the coolest way to do 
it!! No doubt about it! Just as you can 
see!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"There might've been folks stronger than 
me. But when it comes to being cool, I'm 
number one, ain't I?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooooo!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Heh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, do it my way!! Don't you ever 
give up on yourselves! Smile especially 
when it hurts!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I've got no clue what'll happen as a 
result. Even so—!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you live your life giving it your all, 
there will always be someone who roots for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Seize glory together with it! —Now, get 
up on the podium, Trainer!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Let me introduce my absolute best partner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What's with those two...? They look so 
insanely happy...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, I don't care anymore! Ugh, 
seriously, get a room!! Dummy! Big fat 
dummy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vodka pulled me by the hand, and amidst 
all the tussle, we threw our arms over 
each other's shoulders and laughed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The ultimate sense of accomplishment that 
can only be found at the end of an 
uncharted path. Vodka and I savored that 
feeling together.
